lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured matrix of high-luminance circular spots is positioned posterior to the branchial slits, organized into approximately five to six horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible along the upper-lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and lower intensity/shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a smaller commensal fish (remora) visible below the ventral margin of the pectoral fin.
